item.tib: bder gshegs zhi khro lha srung spyi yi skong bshags thugs dam dgyes bzhed
item.coloph: ces zhi khro dbyings kyi skong bshags 'di/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pas gsang ba'i brag phug dgu rgyud nas bstan no/ phyi rabs gshen po rnams la bzhag zhi khro dbyings kyi skong bshags rdzogs so/ gshen po rang don gyi skong bshags 'di ni bla chen dran pa nam mkhas sham po'i brag la sbas/ phyis su rma ston shes rab seng ges bton nas spa rin chen lhun grub la gnang nas dar//
